global_events: Brent crude above $95 and fresh US tariff-hike threats are keeping global sentiment cautious, with trading partners under pressure to close deals and India and China signalling they will push back. US consumer confidence improved after the midterm results, but inflation worries linger, and France faces a recession risk. The rupee slipped about 20 paise to around 92.40 per dollar in early trade as the oil spike unwound part of its recent rally and lifted forward premiums.
central_banks: US core inflation as measured by the Fed's preferred gauge rose to 3.8% in October, which raises the stakes for the Fed in 2027, and commentary suggests further hikes may be needed. Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos is reportedly set to take over as ECB president. The RBI has flagged food-price risks to inflation, and Indian bonds sold off alongside the oil jump.
policy_sentiment: The RBI's warning on food inflation and a sharp bond sell-off tilt the tone hawkish for rate-sensitive sectors. India's response to the US tariff threats is another factor to monitor.

research.why: Nature Nanotechnology demonstration of a hybrid core pairing VO2 Mott leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, linking spintronic memory to neuromorphic computing.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature paper showing coherent parity oscillations between states encoded in four poor man's Majoranas in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains, a step toward topologically protected qubits.
research.title: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

research.why: Nature Physics demonstration of two-qubit gates between interacting electron qubits on solid neon, advancing a promising qubit platform.
research.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon

research.why: PRL theory identifying a Rashba-type interfacial spin-lattice coupling that yields kineoelasticity and nonreciprocal phonons, relevant to magnon-phonon coupled dynamics.
research.title: Kineoelasticity and Nonreciprocal Phonons by Rashba-Induced Interfacial Spin-Lattice Coupling

research.why: PRL protocol for high-purity spin entanglement through a magnon bus despite weak coupling, by coupling magnons only to a transition outside the computational basis, which removes the usual fidelity-versus-decay trade-off.
research.title: High-Purity Entanglement Mediated by Magnons Despite Weak Coupling

research.why: PRL report of giant room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling in nanocomposite thin films through strain-sensitive polarization, relevant to voltage control of magnetism.
research.title: Giant Room-Temperature Magnetoelectric Coupling Effect in Nanocomposite Thin Films via Strain-Sensitive Polarization

research.why: Nature news feature on general-purpose LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) gaining protein design and structure prediction abilities once limited to specialized tools like AlphaFold.
research.title: Watch out, AlphaFold: Claude and ChatGPT’s new biology skills wow scientists

research.why: arXiv preprint demonstrating mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy with a single NV center via the magnon Kerr effect, a nanoscale quantum-sensing probe of magnetization dynamics.
research.title: Mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy by a single paramagnetic center
